profile.context_note: the longest measured prompt; an unchunked prefill overflows the 256 MiB stage-state codec at about 3,277 tokens (six-hour audit F6), so nothing longer is claimed, and #12408's checked budget with a typed refusal replaces this number once it lands. The 20k case is not claimed.
profile.sampling: greedy (temperature 0); thinking mode with the #12372 adapter's default reasoning effort
profile.beacon: the head's v2 beacon declares deadline_secs 600 and max_output_tokens 4096, and carries its measured answer_profile in its inert meta (NIP-PYLON, Model groups)
profile.why_600: the worst case inside the profile, a 1,526-token prompt (TTFT 52 s) plus a 4,096-token answer at 26.7 tokens/s (153 s), is about 205 s; the measured 4,096-token answer took 155.7 s from admission. 600 s leaves about 2.9 times that

launch: pylon cloud up four-single|two-dual --head stage0 --transport direct --temperature 0 --deadline-secs 600 --max-output-tokens 4096 --step-secs 75 (see deepseek-v41-g6-g7-cross-machine-2026-10-21.json for builds and machines)

harness.checks: answered, extended (pylon.deadline.v1 admitted at the declared deadline), finish stop, within the declared deadline, a final answer (the head splits reasoning off at the model's own token and returns only the final answer), and the final answer's score

measured.prefill: stage after stage: each stage takes 8.7-9.1 s for 1,072 tokens and 12.2-13.0 s for 1,526 (the head times the whole prompt step from stage 0 to the last stage's first token: 36 s and 52 s, inside the 75 s step limit this profile needs; the default 30 s would fail the 1,072-token prompt)

at_the_cap.outcome: reasoning reached the cap; the head refused limit_exceeded and recorded nothing in its profile

measured.answer_parser: the last stage's per-token time grows with the answer: 8.8 ms at about 120 tokens, 9.6 ms at 757, 10.1 ms at 2,154, and 10.9 ms on average over 4,096, while the other stages grow by at most 0.6 ms (attention over a longer cache).
